error: unknown command 'unknown'

Usage: agent-chat [options] [command]

cross-session messaging for Claude Code

Options:
  -V, --version              output the version number
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Human commands:
  inbox [options]            what your agents need from you
  queue [options]            read the human queue; read-only, it cannot answer,
                             approve or endorse
  answer <id> <text...>      answer a question; routes back to the asker
  dismiss <id>               close an item without answering, or decline an
                             endorsement
  approve <id> <allow|deny>  answer an agent's permission prompt from here
  endorse [options] <id>     approve a composed message; delivers it with your
                             authority
  digest [options]           morning digest: asks, decisions, done, stalled,
                             spend and next picks

Commands:
  service                    run and inspect the broker daemon
  mirror                     project the human queue into a Matrix room and fold
                             phone verdicts back
  burndown                   pick and run unattended work for opted-in
                             initiatives
  seats                      autonomy seats: the idle watchdog
  port                       JSON envelope ports for the dispatch factory; none
                             of them starts a broker
  machine                    operator HOLDs, owner stops and the machine stop
  host                       host launchers: machines a teleport can land a
                             successor on
  debug                      diagnostics: sessions, history, routing
  doctor                     check the things that fail silently
  lifecycle                  offline maintenance of the agent lifecycle ledger
  help [command]             display help for command

Agent commands:
  watch [options] <name>     stream messages for a session that cannot receive
                             channel pushes
  agent                      durable agents
  teleport                   teleport control
  handoff                    stored teleport handoffs
  profiles [name]            agent profiles available to spawn with
  gh-calls [options]         read the GitHub call log: top callers and routes,
                             and 403s split by limit
  counts [options]           every count derived from live state, beside what
                             each surface shows, with a verdict per difference
  gh-write <gh-args...>      one gh write after --, spaced machine-wide and
                             retried on the secondary rate limit
  suite-slot <command...>    run a full test suite after --, holding one of the
                             machine-wide full-suite slots
  leak-scan [options]        scan added lines for private data; exit 0 clean, 1
                             findings, 2 cannot pass
  pr-ready [options]         before gh pr create: clean tree, rebase, checks,
                             changeset, leak scan; exit 0 only when all pass

Service commands:
  ask [options] [text...]    put a question to the human under a service label
                             and print its msg_id
  answers [options] <name>   read answers and dismissals to a service label's
